Ahead of him, Max Verstappen (Red Bull) won the race and Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) finished second.
The series began on October 17 and ended on October 31, when the Golden State Valkyries defeated the Atlanta Dream four games to three to claim their first championship in franchise history.
Golden State's Gabby Williams was named the WNBA Finals Most Valuable Player.
